title: Whitehouse residents pin where the dog bins should go
summary: Whitehouse, a new estate on the western edge of Milton Keynes, has outgrown its dog bins. The community council asked residents to drop a pin where a bin was missing. 39 did so in nine days, and the council's next paper recommended six new bins.
credit_note: Dog-bin provision survey, Councillor Julian Thomas
cover_alt: The council's map of Whitehouse: the 14 existing dog bins as blue circles and the six recommended new bins as numbered yellow markers, with their locations listed
cover_credit: The 14 existing bins and the six recommended additions, from the council's September 2026 paper. Map: Whitehouse Community Council.
